label: human-9
people: None in the header (the shim bug of the time) and no player chat in the record. The ledger says: the user's lobby, "opponents Armada air and Cortex bots". Units seen: Armada (commander, constructors, an Aircraft Plant at A4, Banshees, Blitzes) and Cortex (Grunts, Storms, Thuds, Necros). Names and ratings unknown.
our_side: One seat, alone on its team (ai 1, team 2, ally team 1; no allied unit in any sample). Armada from G1 (6899, 681), the north-east corner. Player: Claude Opus 5 at effort low on the claude2 account, in realtime. Hands: Jev 1.13.0 (jev-latest) under the pianist, the old hands before the 2026-10-02 rebuild. No commander role. 35 turns, 11.1 s median wall.

result.minute: 12:55 (the record ends with our commander at 2% at H3; the base was overrun 9:20-10:26)

summary: One Opus 5 low seat played alone against two people (Armada air and Cortex bots) from the north-east corner of Comet Catcher, and its economy never started. By 1:43 the opening had two extractors and six solars. From 2:00 metal stood at 0 with the energy store full, and we never held more than four extractors (income 5-8 all game). Our Rover saw his Aircraft Plant at 2:18, but the report gave only its grid: the player called it a vehicle plant and the plant kept making Blitzes. Single Banshees from 3:54 and Cortex Grunt raids (eight at 6:01) took extractors faster than we rebuilt. The Whistlers asked for at 5:28 came at 8:32, and at 8:13-8:20 six Banshees killed all eight Blitzes, which were stuck on a stale engage 700 elmos west of the Nettles. Storms, Thuds, Grunts and Armada Blitzes then overran a base with no army (9:20-10:26), and the commander fled south-east, hunted to 2%.

root.what: The economy left the path in the opening. The 0:00 packet put two extractors and five solars on the commander. The default added one more solar in the 22 s before the packet landed, so four stood before the plant (started 1:01; pool 0:34). By 2:00 metal was 0 with energy full, and the player's 1:00 and 2:00 turns were 'wait'. The first constructor took 60 s under the stall, so the third extractor came at 2:37 and four was the most ever held.
root.evidence: bot.log 2:00: 'metal 0 (+5.4/-5.4) energy 1350/1350 | mex 2 labs 1 cons 1'; pro_baseline: extractors 2 at 2:00 (pool 3/3/4, <p25), 'solars before the plant 4' vs 2, plant started 1:01 vs 0:34; commander_turns 1:00 and 2:00: 'wait'

turning_points.what: In the 22 s before the first packet landed, the default built extractors at spot_10 and spot_5 and a solar. The list then started from its first step: it skipped spot_10, re-issued spot_5 (already built; the picture did not match that extractor to the spot) and was refused, then built three more solars before the plant (ordered 0:54).

turning_points.what: The Rover (crossed 1:51, within 88 of his start at 2:17) saw his Aircraft Plant at A4. The report listed it as a grid without a type, and at 3:27 the player called it a vehicle plant. The produce stayed Rover, constructors and Blitzes.

their_play: Two opponents, read from their units only (no truth file, so their economy is unknown). The Armada player built an Aircraft Plant at A4, seen at 2:18. His first Banshee came at 3:54, and single Banshees killed an extractor about once a minute (3:59, 5:40, 7:14). A six-Banshee wave at 8:07-8:20 killed all eight Blitzes and then died to the Nettles, and four more hunted our commander at 11:29-11:41. His Blitzes were in our base from 9:21. The Cortex player opened bots: a Storm near his base at 2:27, Grunt raids from 3:29, eight Grunts at H2/H1 at 6:01. At 9:27 seven Storms, two Thuds and Grunts came in at spot_6 alongside the Armada Blitzes, and the base fell 9:20-10:26; Necros appeared at 10:04. No tier 2 or static defence of theirs was seen. Every fight was in our half (their losses 2,054 at our base, 675 in our half). In a 1v2 they pressed early, air raids and bot raids together, while we sat on four extractors.

The list re-issued the step and was refused at 0:28, every report listed spot_5 as free, and the player re-ordered it (7:03, 9:02, 9:20), drawing refusals at 8:18 and 9:17. The refusal was a duplicate, not a lost extractor; this differs from the ledger's reading.

bears_on.note: Six solars by 1:43, four of them before the plant. The energy store was full from 1:00 while metal was 0 from 2:00 (stall4 86 s).
Three-plus solars without a fast constructor: the plant's first unit was a Rover at 1:21, and the constructor took 1:32-2:32 under a metal stall. Two solars and an earlier plant would have fitted.
The plant stood at 1:20, and the commander left at once for two more solars (1:21-1:42, 1:43-2:25) rather than assisting.
Never more than four extractors and income 5-8, alone against two people. The loss traces to the extractor count before any fight.
The air and the overrun were the visible cause (and the player's debrief says 'Air decided it'), but at 2-4 extractors no unit choice could have paid for both anti-air and an army.
'Scout your opponent and pre-emptively go air': we scouted the air plant at 2:18, but anti-air came only after the first Banshee (the plant's type was missing from the report).
The Rover crossed at 1:51 and was within 88 of his start at 2:17 (pool: in his half by 1:40), finding the air plant. It was the only unit of ours ever in his half; no pressure followed.

bears_on.note: Three constructors by 8:00 (pool 4/5/7). The first took 60 s under the stall, and the expansion lists came at 3:15.

lens.caveats: No truth file, batch.json or results.jsonl: the opponents' numbers are only what we saw, and the 1v2 shape comes from the ledger plus the two factions seen. The only record is seat 1 (record-1.jsonl). wake_read hardcodes strategist-0/record-0, so it was run on scratchpad symlinks aliasing seat 1; impedance_sweep needed --seat 1. pro_baseline found no carded side from G1 and ran with --all-starts; the pool is OS 40+ duels, so it bounds only our own clocks in a 1v2. analyze_match reads outcome None. Three deaths at 9:35-10:05 are credited to 'xmasball2_6' (a seasonal ornament unit), which cannot be interpreted. The record's banner chat is attributed to player 0 as 'keithphw is Within Reason'. The ledger says the engine refused the spot_5 extractor and so the economy never passed four; the record shows the spot_5 extractor built at 0:10 and the refusal was a duplicate order, so the reader puts the root in the packet and the stall, not the refusal.

open_questions: How many opponent seats were there, and who played them? Neither the header nor the chat names anyone. The units show one Armada and one Cortex seat, and the ledger says the user's lobby.
Was this winnable for one seat against two people from a corner with a pool-shaped opening (7 extractors by 4:00)? With no truth file, their economy and army are unknown.
Was the 'unclaimed soldiers stand at: A1' line in the picture (seen with no soldiers) fixed, and when?

The spot_5 extractor stood 113 elmos from the table point (-72, +88), while the ledger measured BARb's extractors at (+40, +72) from the table at this start. Do the two offsets agree with the centroid fix, or did our placement differ from the game's?
